# California DMV Practice Test

> Free practice tests for the California DMV knowledge test: 496 questions on the Driver's Handbook, each answer backed by its own words. No ads, no sign-up.

Unofficial: not affiliated with the California DMV.
The handbook text is the DMV's: California Driver’s Handbook, California Department of Motor Vehicles, licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. This copy is from November 2026. Reformatted for the web and divided into shorter parts; the handbook’s text is unchanged. The practice questions and explanations are ours, based on it.
Original: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/

## Data

Each section's facts are testable statements, each with the handbook text it quotes. Its questions are multiple choice, with the answer, an explanation and the facts they test.

- [The DMV's sample tests](https://ca-dmv-test.dfrancour.dev/data/questions/dmv-samples.json)
- [The handbook, as imported](https://ca-dmv-test.dfrancour.dev/data/handbook/edition.json): its sections, in data/handbook/sections/
